# Photobook fonts

The unmodified static TrueType files in `app/assets/fonts` are served locally for previews and embedded in print PDFs. All use the SIL Open Font License 1.1; each font's license and copyright notice is included here.

| Font | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cormorant Garamond Regular and Italic | [Cormorant project](https://github.com/CatharsisFonts/Cormorant/tree/master/fonts/ttf) | `cormorant/OFL.txt` |
| Noto Serif Regular | [Noto fonts](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSerif) | `noto_serif/OFL.txt` |
| Lato Light | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lato) | `lato/OFL.txt` |
| Noto Sans Regular | [Noto fonts](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans) | `noto_sans/OFL.txt` |

CSS family aliases keep photobook typography separate from the application's fonts. No font download or external font request is required at runtime.
